<role>

</role>
<definition>
Question: is the core problem still open, not solved by a shipped story and not covered by a roadmap item? Pass means yes.
Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is unclear document versioning in claim files. I checked the five most similar items: the Claims timeline page (chronological claim view, not versioning), completed story 4127 (bulk document upload), in-progress 4135 (claim information display), unstarted 4137 (reporting navigation), and completed 4128 (claim search refinements). None address document version tracking or identifying the current version of a document, and no roadmap item covers it. The core problem remains open.", "verdict": "pass"}
